faqs.question: What is MSG91 Reports?
faqs.answer: MSG91 Reports is a centralized communication analytics platform that provides detailed reports for SMS, WhatsApp, Email, Voice, OTP, RCS, Push Notifications, Short URLs, and other communication channels from a single dashboard.

faqs.question: What communication channels can I analyze?
faqs.answer: You can monitor analytics for SMS, WhatsApp Business API, Email, Voice Calls, OTP, RCS Messaging, Push Notifications, Short URLs, Campaigns, and other MSG91 communication services.

faqs.question: Can I monitor SMS delivery reports?
faqs.answer: Yes. MSG91 Reports provides real-time SMS delivery reports, delivery success rates, failed message analytics, filtered messages, click tracking, and campaign performance insights.

faqs.question: Does MSG91 provide WhatsApp Business Analytics?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can monitor WhatsApp message delivery, read receipts, replies, click tracking, failed messages, customer engagement, campaign performance, and communication trends.

faqs.question: Can I track OTP delivery and verification reports?
faqs.answer: Yes. MSG91 Reports provides OTP delivery analytics, verification success reports, resend analytics, channel-wise OTP performance, and authentication insights across SMS, WhatsApp, Email, and Voice.

faqs.question: Can I compare communication campaigns?
faqs.answer: Yes. Compare campaign performance across SMS, WhatsApp, Email, Voice, RCS, and Push Notifications to identify the highest-performing communication channel.

faqs.question: Can reports be exported?
faqs.answer: Yes. Download detailed communication reports, analytics, delivery logs, and audit-ready exports for marketing, finance, compliance, customer support, and operations teams.

faqs.question: Does MSG91 provide real-time analytics?
faqs.answer: Yes. The dashboard updates communication metrics in real time, enabling businesses to monitor delivery performance, customer engagement, campaign results, and operational health instantly.

faqs.question: Can I filter reports by campaign or account?
faqs.answer: Yes. Use advanced filters to analyze reports by campaign, account, communication channel, date range, message status, delivery status, and other reporting parameters.

faqs.question: Which teams benefit from MSG91 Reports?
faqs.answer: MSG91 Reports is designed for Marketing, Customer Support, Operations, Finance, Product, Engineering, Compliance, and Leadership teams that need complete visibility into customer communications.

faqs.question: How do communication reports help improve business performance?
faqs.answer: Communication reports help businesses identify delivery failures, improve campaign performance, increase customer engagement, optimize communication costs, monitor operational KPIs, and make informed business decisions based on real-time analytics.

faqs.question: Is MSG91 Reports suitable for enterprise businesses?
faqs.answer: Yes. MSG91 Reports is built to handle high-volume communication analytics with scalable reporting, advanced filtering, exportable reports, and enterprise-grade dashboards for organizations of all sizes.
